subject: What AI helpers will ask you to hand over
headline: Every AI company wants to run your life. What will each one ask you to hand over?

files.name: 1-what-the-reviews-say.png
files.purpose: So why not just use ChatGPT or Claude? You ask those a question and they answer. Muse goes off and does the job. Meta gives Muse its own computer in the cloud. Muse opens websites, fills in forms and sends emails for you.

files.name: 3-how-good-are-they.png
files.purpose: ChatGPT and Claude can do jobs like this too. But you usually pay. Muse is free, and it's built into apps you already use, like Instagram and WhatsApp. That's the real difference.

files.name: 2-five-bets.png
files.purpose: Each company is going after a different part of your life. Meta wants your personal life, OpenAI wants your work, Google wants your Gmail, Anthropic the careful assistant for work, Apple the private one.

files.name: 4-three-places.png
files.purpose: Here's the catch. To do your errands, an assistant needs your emails, your passwords and your bank card. All of that has to be kept somewhere. There are three ways. Your details stay on your own phone.

files.name: 5-the-ads.png
files.purpose: The ads. Meta makes almost all its money from ads. Shops will pay to be the one Muse recommends.

files.name: 6-my-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction: by 30 June 2027 OpenAI, Google or Anthropic will launch an assistant that shops for you, with your data scrambled, so even they can't read it. 55%.
